full_judgment: 8. The High Court Division came to the finding that the Government-leave-petitioner having knowledge of limitation and without sufficient cause slept over the matter and allowed the period of limitation to run out. If this sort of negligence was condoned by the Court then the litigant public would be at the mercy of the State functionary since in this application the Government-petitioner had utterly failed to explain the delay.
